Conditional Agreement in German: B2 Phrase Practice

Express agreement subject to a stated condition in German. Practise unter der Bedingung, vorausgesetzt and sofern with translations and explained B2 answers.

B2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Useful phrases and patterns

An agreement can be limited by a stated condition: Ich stimme zu, sofern … . Unter der Bedingung, dass … names the condition directly. Vorausgesetzt, dass … introduces what must hold first. Unter Vorbehalt signals a reservation rather than unconditional approval. Make the actual condition explicit.

Common mistake to avoid

A conditional yes is different from an unqualified yes. Sofern introduces a condition here, not simply a point in time.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice what the speaker wants to do, the level of politeness and the details the listener needs.

Worked example 1Ich stimme unter der Bedingung zu, dass die offenen Fragen vorher geklärt werden.I agree on the condition that the open questions are clarified first.
Worked example 2Vorausgesetzt, dass alle die Unterlagen erhalten, können wir beginnen.Provided that everyone receives the documents, we can begin.
Worked example 3Ich kann dem Vorgehen zustimmen, sofern die Zuständigkeiten eindeutig sind.I can agree to the procedure provided the responsibilities are clear.
Worked example 4Meine Zusage erfolgt unter Vorbehalt der abschließenden Bestätigung.My acceptance is subject to final confirmation.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the agreement frame with the condition noun, connector or reservation noun specified by the cue. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Bedingung · sofern · Vorausgesetzt · Vorbehalt

Question 1. Ich stimme unter der ___ zu, dass wir die Angaben prüfen. (condition)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Bedingung

Unter der Bedingung names the stated condition.

Question 2. ___, dass alle informiert sind, können wir fortfahren. (provided)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Vorausgesetzt

Vorausgesetzt, dass introduces the prerequisite and is capitalised here.

Question 3. Ich bin einverstanden, ___ wir den Umfang begrenzen. (provided that)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: sofern

Sofern introduces the condition on agreement.

Question 4. Die Zustimmung erfolgt unter ___. (reservation)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Vorbehalt

Unter Vorbehalt makes the reservation explicit.

Use it in your own sentence

Agree to a plan only if responsibilities are clarified beforehand.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich stimme zu, sofern wir die Zuständigkeiten vorher klären.

Check your wording: The condition qualifies the agreement; it is not unconditional approval.

What to practise next

Adapt a model to a different listener or situation. Keep the request, time reference and formal or informal address consistent.
